_readme: The reference set for the website scan. Add real customer and prospect sites here, 20 to 30 of them, across industries and including ones that scanned badly. Only `url` is required. Add `expect` for anything you know to be true (name, phone, industry id from the signup dropdown, a few services the site clearly offers): the score then checks the scan against it instead of only checking that something was found. Run with: bun run scan:eval

sites.note: The site that started this work: it refused a plain request (2026-11-13).
